provenance: Reconstruction of the buffer-marker state left behind by a real cursor-agent session on 2026-08-03 (live fleet load). The defect produces a CONFIDENT WRONG NUMBER, not a gap, which is why nothing downstream could notice it.
privacy: NO real session content lives in this directory. The marker VALUES are integers and a branch name; the session id is SYNTHETIC. The transcript this pattern is proven against is the already-scrubbed corpus copy referenced above (its meta.json records scrubbed: true, and it is guarded by the fixture privacy byte-scan) -- verified structurally identical, line for line and tool for tool, to the preserved raw session. why_it_exists: The controlled repro of this session PASSES against the same transcript, same machine, same build -- so 'the repro passes after the fix' proves nothing. This is the known-bad input for the liveness DETECTOR: the detector must FIRE on this shape (a watermark frozen at 2 while the source runs to 56) before any fix is attempted, so that its later silence can mean something.
scrub_survival_contract: The scrub must not flatten the property this fixture is kept for. Any test using it asserts the pattern IN THE FIXTURE ITSELF -- 56 non-empty lines, a watermark of 2 far below them, and the 9 ApplyPatch edits still present in the un-consumed window -- not merely that the detector said something.
